summary.name: ResumeAI
summary.one_liner: ResumeAI is a web-based AI resume builder with a free ATS resume checker that scores pasted resume text against its own rubric.
use_cases: Checking a resume's ATS-readability score before applying
Finding job-description keywords missing from a resume
Building a resume from a template with AI suggestions
Downloading a formatted PDF or Word resume
Looking up which ATS an employer's careers portal uses
summary.what_it_does: The site offers a free ATS checker where users paste resume text and optionally a job description to get a 0-100 score with feedback on keywords, formatting, sections, content, and length, under ResumeAI's own rubric. The AI builder can parse a pasted resume, suggest bullet edits and job-description terms for the user to accept or reject, and preview the result. Clean PDF or DOCX downloads require a paid plan. The page also lists resume examples for 580+ job titles, free resume tools such as a grader and bullet generator, and a dataset of which ATS employers use.
notable: ATS checker that needs no signup, with 3 checks a day anonymous and 10 a day with a free account
Pro Pass one-time $12.99 for PDF/DOCX downloads and all 9 templates, with no subscription
State of ATS 2026 dataset mapping employers to the ATS vendor on their careers portal (Workday leads at 48.2% of 421 re-verified employers)
caveats: Score uses ResumeAI's own rubric and does not test the resume inside an employer's ATS or predict interviews
Downloads of clean PDF and Word files require a paid plan; the page lists $9.99/mo annual and $0.99 first-month intro options as well
Free plan is limited to 2 resumes, 2 templates, 2 AI generations, and daily ATS check caps
